Home Screen icon

New task

Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. The icon it makes opens Slate with the quick-add sheet up, on a new task.

Add it from Safari — a web app cannot install another one, so this page does nothing from inside Slate itself.

This page exists because iOS launches an installed web app at the address it was installed with, and throws away anything added to the URL afterwards. The address has to be baked in at the moment you add it, which is what adding this page rather than the app does. On Android you need none of it: long-press the Slate icon instead.
